description:
Generate a new set of WooCommerce REST API keys for a shipping integration. 

1. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Advanced > REST API.
2. Add a new key with the description 'ShipStation Integration'.
3. Set the User to 'admin'.
4. Set Permissions to 'Read/Write'.
5. Generate the key.
6. Copy the Consumer Key and Consumer Secret (displayed only once).
7. Save them to a file named 'api_credentials.txt' in the home directory (/home/ga/api_credentials.txt) using the following format:

Description: ShipStation Integration
Consumer Key: ck_xxxxxxxx...
Consumer Secret: cs_xxxxxxxx...
